typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		OPPORTUNITY_ID as string,
		KPIT_REQUEST_DT as string,
		INVENTORY_ID as string,
		MAIL_ADDR1 as string,
		MAIL_ADDR2 as string,
		MAIL_CITY as string,
		MAIL_STATE as string,
		MAIL_ZIP as string,
		MAIL_ZIP4 as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_fulfillment*']) ~> source1
ConditionalSplit1@Upsert derive(Mailing_Street__c = concatWS(' ',MAIL_ADDR1,MAIL_ADDR2),
		Mailing_Postal_Code__c = concatWS('-', MAIL_ZIP, MAIL_ZIP4),
		Request_Date__c = coalesce(toString(toDate(KPIT_REQUEST_DT,'yyyyMMdd')),KPIT_REQUEST_DT),
		{Shipment_Speed__c } = "Fulfillment House",
		Status__c = "Pending") ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Contact__c = CONTACT_ID,
		Opportunity__c = OPPORTUNITY_ID,
		Request_Date__c,
		Mailing_Street__c,
		Mailing_City__c = MAIL_CITY,
		Mailing_State__c = MAIL_STATE,
		Mailing_Postal_Code__c,
		Shipment_Speed__c = {Shipment_Speed__c },
		Status__c,
		OTN__c = INVENTORY_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
source1 derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId1
addADFId1 split(isNull(CONTACT_ID)||isNull(KPIT_REQUEST_DT)||isNull(INVENTORY_ID)||isNull(MAIL_ADDR1)||isNull(MAIL_CITY)||isNull(MAIL_STATE)||isNull(MAIL_ZIP),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(Reject, Upsert)
ConditionalSplit1@Reject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Required Field Contains NULL Value: ', iif(isNull(CONTACT_ID), 'CONTACT_ID ', ''), iif(isNull(KPIT_REQUEST_DT), 'KPIT_REQUEST_DT', ''), iif(isNull(INVENTORY_ID), 'INVENTORY_ID', ''), iif(isNull(MAIL_ADDR1), 'MAIL_ADDR1', ''), iif(isNull(MAIL_CITY), 'MAIL_CITY', ''), iif(isNull(MAIL_STATE), 'MAIL_STATE', ''), iif(isNull(MAIL_ZIP), 'MAIL_ZIP', ''))) ~> rejectReason
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_fulfillment_Fulfillment_Orders__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertFulfillmentOrder
addADFId1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_fulfillment_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedRaw
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_fulfillment_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toReject
